hud.method: Exact production Web; synthetic full roster and three heroes, 1440x900 DPR1. One 60-second sample per race. Not comparable by subtraction to scene-only matrix; no private GPU hook.

visual.method: Paused same-state output comparisons; not death-animation, temporal shimmer or reference-client acceptance.

r1Reassessment.scope: Post-sample audit; original R1 records are unchanged and retain their initial validity implementation.
r1Reassessment.reasonForNewRevision: R1 checked whole-window low sampling but missed a short burst of unexplained 1 Hz callbacks.
r1Reassessment.interpretation: Do not attribute the gap to gameplay simulation or report this sample as valid performance. Browser/OS scheduling or occlusion remains unproven. R2 rejects unexplained individual callback gaps and retains genuinely attributed CPU/long-task stalls.

checks.evidence: regression-final.log and completed terminal check chain

interpretation: Valid measurements can be slow. Synthetic fixtures and short windows do not satisfy the existing 3x180s natural performance contract.
